definitions.compute_break_even_reuse_count: reuses until the acquisition primitive calls are repaid, measured against the naive route

memoisation_only.sense: the enumeration again with warm caches; it memoises nothing

recomputation_reduction.sense: partial evaluation / memoization, kept apart: `memoisation_only` is the SAME baseline run a second time with the caches left warm. Whatever it saves is remembering, not representation.

generic_improvement_alone.sense: merging equal states, a standard technique, with no learned representation. What the representation adds is the step from here, not from the naive enumeration

search_reduction.units: candidates_generated counts what was expanded -- words on the naive rung, distinct raw states on the generic rung, distinct observation vectors on the represented one. search_nodes counts state updates against matrix actions. rejected_candidates is in WORDS on every rung, because the merging rungs carry the multiplicity

state_reduction.sense: the generic rung keeps two states apart whenever their frame or centre differs, even where the question cannot tell them apart. The observation vector is what the question actually reads.

checks.name: transition

premise.centre: symbolic; every integer centre is covered
premise.scope: exact for every frame the alphabet reaches within 4 folds and every centre

checks.scope: all finite words; linear closure of supplied polynomial observations
checks.statement: Phi(T_g(x)) = B_g Phi(x) for every letter g

checks.name: observable
checks.scope: every state, not only the reachable ones
checks.statement: the observable is an exact linear combination of the basis, so Phi determines it at every state

checks.goal: the words of a given length whose value of c1 is maximal, and how many there are
checks.name: goal
checks.statement: the goal is stated as a predicate on the observed value, so it is preserved exactly when the observable is

checks.name: legality
checks.statement: legality is constant on the classes Phi induces on words

certificate.notes: the collision-free variant constrains the WORD, not the state it ends in, so no function of the final state can express it
certificate.sense: merging two words because their observations agree is sound for this task only under this certificate. A refusal is a counterexample and is final for the task; an admission without a proof carries the depth it was checked to.
certificate.task: fold displacement along axis 1, collision-free words only

records.name: fold search, collision-free: length 8
records.reason: the certificate does not admit this representation for this task, so it was not used and nothing was measured with it

representation.closure_scope: all finite words; linear closure of supplied polynomial observations
